body: ArenaSnapshotMsg never included node data at all -- only heroes[], winner, phase, picked[]. In net_mode the client never calls arena_init()/arena_init_teams() locally (the server owns that), so arena_state.nodes[] stayed at the zeroed global default (both at the origin), making both capture nodes render on top of each other. Added ArenaNodeSnapshot (x/z/owner/capturing_team/capture_progress_ms) to the wire format, populated server-side, consumed client-side. Also colored node cubes by owner now that ownership data actually reaches the client -- the territory redesign's whole visual point. Verified: build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh all clean. Wire-format change, so restarted all three live systemd units (matchmaker-bots, matchmaker-players, bot-pool) on the new build; confirmed the pool re-fills cleanly to 19/20 with no crash/size-mismatch. REDGARDEN 36f868e.
title: Capture nodes rendering compressed onto one point, fixed (S170-87)
